# Bun: type

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

When debugging Bun runtime issues, agents need to know the inspector type endpoint returns SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: the specific type values for ConsoleAPICalledEventDataType, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: the JSON schema of the type response, and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: the inspector API version and authentication requirements. Without this, agents cannot determine whether to trust type information or request additional context.

Search intents:
- bun inspector type
- bun runtime type
- bun debug type

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/bun-inspector-type --json
